what_i_see: A 3-arcsec chain of small blue knots and short curved fragments, with a compact red galaxy about 2 arcsec to the east. The field is crowded with red early-type galaxies, suggesting a group or cluster.
most_likely: A clumpy star-forming irregular or chain galaxy at z near 0.9, seen behind or beside a foreground group.
against_it: Blue curved fragments beside a red galaxy in a rich field resemble faint lensed arclets; but the red galaxy looks too small for that image separation.
decisive_test: Deeper high-resolution colour imaging or spectra: identical redshifts and mirrored structure in the fragments would indicate lensing.
catalogue_notes: Legacy photo-z 0.99±0.48 at 0.7 arcsec (poor quality); 0.85±0.11 at 4.7. NED: WISEA sources 10.9, MRSS 154-018862 at 15.8. SIMBAD LEDA 422949 at 49.7. Gaia none within 16. Four lens lists: no match within 60.
